# exp-011: LLaMA-3.1-8B-Instruct SICA evaluation (cross-family validation)

# Claim 2 cross-model-family validation (non-Qwen architecture)
set -e
cd /root/symb_invariant_consensus
source /root/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh && conda activate base

MODEL="/root/autodl-tmp/models/Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct/LLM-Research/Meta-Llama-3___1-8B-Instruct"
PORT=8002
RESULTS_DIR="results/exp011_llama8b"
mkdir -p "$RESULTS_DIR"

# Cleanup stale vLLM processes on this port
pkill -f "vllm.entrypoints.*--port 8002" 2>/dev/null || true
sleep 2

# Step 1: Start vLLM in background
echo "=== [$(date)] Starting vLLM (LLaMA-3.1-8B-Instruct) on port $PORT ==="
python -m vllm.entrypoints.openai.api_server \
    --model "$MODEL" \
    --max-model-len 8192 \
    --gpu-memory-utilization 0.90 \

    --trust-remote-code \

echo "=== [$(date)] Running SICA pipeline: K=12, T=0.7, 60 problems ==="

    --temperature 0.7 \
    --max-tokens 8192 \
    --api-base "http://localhost:$PORT/v1" \

    --folio-data data/folio_30.json \
    --output "$RESULTS_DIR/exp011_results.json" \
    --save-intermediates \
    --seed 42

# Step 4: Cleanup
echo "=== [$(date)] Stopping vLLM ==="
kill $VLLM_PID 2>/dev/null || true
wait $VLLM_PID 2>/dev/null || true
echo "EXP011_DONE"

当前脚本只清理了 port 8002 上的 vLLM 进程，没有处理其他残留 vLLM（如 Qwen-14B）。我来添加通用清理逻辑，并检查模型路径和参数。

import re

with open('/root/symb_invariant_consensus/scripts/run_exp011_llama8b.sh', 'r') as f:
    content = f.read()

# Replace the existing narrow cleanup with a broader one
old_cleanup = """# Cleanup stale vLLM processes on this port
pkill -f "vllm.entrypoints.*--port 8002" 2>/dev/null || true
sleep 2"""

new_cleanup = """# 清理残留 vLLM 进程（包括可能占用 GPU 的 Qwen 等其他模型）
echo "Cleaning up any existing vLLM processes..."
pkill -9 -f "vllm.entrypoints" 2>/dev/null || true
sleep 5
# 验证 GPU 已释放
echo "GPU status after cleanup:"

content = content.replace(old_cleanup, new_cleanup)

# Also fix max-tokens from 8192 to 4096 (LLaMA-8B doesn't need that much)
content = content.replace('    --max-tokens 8192 \\', '    --max-tokens 4096 \\')

with open('/root/symb_invariant_consensus/scripts/run_exp011_llama8b.sh', 'w') as f:
    f.write(content)

print("Done")
PYEOF
python3 /tmp/patch_exp011.py
